overview: Pocket Breaker is a ball-and-paddle arcade game with six broad stained-glass bands. Move the paddle under the returning ball to keep it rebounding through the colored rows. Clear all six before a missed return or the run’s time limit ends the attempt.
rules: Each uncleared band disappears after a ball collision; clear all six to win.
The side and top boundaries bounce the ball; the paddle returns a descending ball upward.
A ball falling below the paddle area loses the attempt.
The rules also end an uncleared run after 5,400 simulation ticks.
controls: Click/Enter starts; mouse or Left/Right arrows steer the paddle.
K saves; L resumes; R restarts; M toggles sound.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
